title: Wayfare Pro Programme Terms, Part 5: Pro Boost Rate on Quest Rewards
content:
**5.1** A quest reward credited under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** carries a Pro boost: the reward amount stated on the quest offer is multiplied by one plus the Pro boost rate, the rate being taken as it stands after it has been multiplied by any scale applying to the boost. Amounts added to a quest reward are added after that multiplication, and the quest reward is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**5.2** The Pro boost rate follows the Wayfare Pro status recorded on the earnings account for the current quarter and the current rating on the driver's driver services agreement under **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing**:

- Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite with a rating at or above 4.9 earns 0.1;
- Wayfare Pro Silver or Gold with a rating at or above 4.85 earns 0.05;
- any other status, or a lower rating, earns no boost.

## Part 5.2 by status and rating

| Status recorded for the current quarter | Current rating on the agreement | Pro boost rate |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | 4.9 or higher | 0.1 |
| Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | Below 4.9 | None |
| Silver or Gold | 4.85 or higher | 0.05 |
| Silver or Gold | Below 4.85 | None |
| Blue | Any | None |

## Edges (hypothetical drivers)

| Status | Rating | Pro boost rate |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 4.90 | 0.1 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 4.89 | None |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 4.85 | 0.05 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 4.84 | None |

A Wayfare Pro Platinum driver rated 4.87 earns no boost: 4.87 meets the Silver and Gold rating line but not the Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite line of 4.9.

**Hypothetical figure.** A stated reward of 80.00 at a Pro boost rate of 0.05, with the rate standing unscaled, becomes 84.00 (80.00 multiplied by 1.05).
